entities.name: Mircea Dobrescu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mircea Dobrescu was a flyweight boxer from Romania. He competed at the 1952, 1956, and 1960 Olympics and won a silver medal in 1956, losing to Terence Spinks on points. He won two more silver medals at the European championships in 1955 and 1957.
